## Test de visualización dinámica

``` {python}
#| output: true
import numpy as np, plotly.graph_objects as go
x=np.linspace(0,10,100)
fig=go.Figure()
fig.add_scatter(y=np.sin(x),x=x)
fig.add_scatter(y=np.cos(x),x=x)
fig.show()
```
